primary_model.preregistered_sign_basis: discovery-sample intensive-margin change points at x=1.00-1.05 (ETH5) and 0.90-1.00 (BASE5) with accelerating post-kink slope; discovery slope-difference CI [4.33,4.51] bp/unit x on the pre-consolidation aggregate object

inference.may_be_changed_only_if: a technical defect is found and fixed before any confirmatory outcome is estimated

calendar_stability.fallback_trigger: fewer than 5 clean UTC days in a monthly partition

secondary_objects: E[C|x] aggregate + exact decomposition identity, fail-closed residual gate 1e-10
free change-point search, grid 0.30:0.05:2.00, descriptive only
BASE1 fixed-c=1 model, labeled NOT_IDENTIFIED if free-CP bootstrap edge share > 0.10

discovery_window_excluded.exclusion_rule: DISCOVERY_ONLY = true; these calendar days are never part of the confirmatory estimation sample

hard_constraints: no window/threshold/bin/grid/reference-rule choice based on outcomes
no receive-time substitution for exchange time
no paid data source unless public archives documented insufficient
